text:
Jordan: POC kickoff with FinanceGuard tomorrow. They want a 1-page acceptance criteria + a short runbook for PrivateDeploy connectivity. Main asks: preserve client IP, static egress allowlist, and support their TLS-inspect proxy. Can someone draft? cc @Maya @Omar
Maya: Happy to. Quick clarifying Qs: will they accept interface endpoints (PrivateLink) to our management/control plane, or do they require peering/TGW?
Jordan: They prefer PrivateLink but have an internal policy review that may force peering. So include both options and clearly call out tradeoffs.
Omar: Drafting firewall snippet for their network team (outbound from connector hosts):
```
# outbound TLS to Redwood management & model endpoints
ALLOW tcp 443 to management.<region>.redwood-hosted.net and models.<region>.redwood-hosted.net
# DNS
ALLOW udp 53 to <customer-dns-ip> or 8.8.8.8
# NTP
ALLOW udp 123 to 0.pool.ntp.org
# If using PrivateLink: allow ENI IPs of interface endpoints (we will provide list)
# If peering: allow egress to provided model IP ranges / ASNs (we will provide)
```
Maya: Key operational notes to call out: 1) To preserve client src IP, do not SNAT before the onprem proxy (route connector -> proxy directly). 2) If customer requires TLS interception, they must either passthrough SNI or we establish mTLS between connector and their proxy. 3) Stable egress IPs required for allowlisting.
security-bot: Security short bullets for questionnaire: Data-in-transit: TLS 1.2+ (TLS1.3 recommended). Key mgmt: Option A: customer KMS (HSM) for envelope keys; Option B: Redwood-managed keys with attestation. Audit logs: configurable export to s3/syslog, retention options 30/90/365d. Operator controls: RBAC + audit trail; emergency egress kill switch (documented + auditable).
deploy-bot: Run this smoke test after allowlist applied:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood-hosted.net/healthz --resolve "api.redwood-hosted.net:443:<connector-ip>"
```
Omar: Ops tests to include in runbook:
- from bastion: curl health check with --resolve to connector IP
- tcpdump on proxy to confirm original src IP
- openssl s_client -connect <proxy>:443 -servername api.redwood-hosted.net to verify SNI passthrough
- verify route table entries point connector subnet to proxy without NAT
Maya: Minimal one-page acceptance criteria (suggested):
- PrivateLink or peering topology agreed and documented
- Interface endpoint ENI IPs or model IP ranges whitelisted
- DNS/NTP access validated
- Client IP preservation validated via tcpdump sample
- TLS handshake validated (openssl s_client)
- Smoke health check successful from bastion
- Security questionnaire bullets acknowledged and signed off
Jordan: Sales/pricing note: include PrivateDeploy base fee + infra surcharge. If they need static egress IPs and reserved GPU pools, propose reserved-capacity add-on (12mo discount). I will add dollar figures in the external proposal doc.
Maya: I'll prepare the 1-page checklist + 1-page runbook and paste here in ~45m. Keep wording concise for their network ops.
Jordan: Great, thanks team :thumbsup:
